slot.brief: Astronomical telescope with given objective and eyepiece focal lengths; find magnifying power and tube length (or find focal lengths given both quantities).

stem: An astronomical telescope is in normal adjustment. Its objective and eyepiece have focal lengths $100$ cm and $5$ cm, respectively. What are its magnifying power and tube length?

verdicts.working: For normal adjustment, magnifying power = 100/5 = 20 and tube length = 100 + 5 = 105 cm.

working:
$M=\dfrac{f_o}{f_e}=\dfrac{100}{5}=20$
$L=f_o+f_e=100+5=105\ \text{cm}$

Independent check: For normal adjustment, magnifying power = 100/5 = 20 and tube length = 100 + 5 = 105 cm.
solution:
For a telescope in normal adjustment, $M=\dfrac{f_o}{f_e}$ and $L=f_o+f_e$.
$$M=\dfrac{100}{5}=20,\qquad L=100+5=105\ \text{cm}$$
